startMessage.line1: Your partner's solo trip with a friend of the opposite sex vs daily location sharing—what would you pick?
startMessage.line2: Jealousy can feel like proof of love—or tip into obsession when it crosses a line. Choosing between two imperfect options shows who you are in front of jealousy.
startMessage.line3: Twelve extreme rounds reveal your jealousy style. Pick the side that fits you better.
startMessage.line4: Start the extreme picks ⚖️ Keep it quick
